verses.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.2: And he said to the children of Israel, “Do not sin through ignorance in any of the commandments of the LORD. For we must not violate any of His commands.”
verses.3: If the priest who is a prophet sins, and offers sacrifices for his sin—a sin he committed by killing an innocent boy to Jehovah—then he shall be punished for his sin.
verses.4: And he brought the grain to the entrance of the priest’s tent, before Jehovah. He placed his hand on the head of the grain, and he cut the grain up before Jehovah.
verses.5: And the priest of the Lord took the blood from the apple, and brought it to the altar.
verses.6: And the priest shall dip his finger into the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before Jehovah, in front of the sacred altar.
verses.7: And the priest shall take some of the blood from the altar, and put it on the horns of the altar before Jehovah, who is in the Temple of God. All the blood that is spilled at the altar shall be poured out into the trench around the altar.
verses.8: And all the milk from the crops that have been affected by sin shall be removed from them. Also, all the milk that covers the crops shall be removed as well.
verses.9: And we shall remove those two pots, as well as the milk that is on them, and also the oil that is on the jars. We shall also remove everything that is on the dishes.
verses.10: When the priests offer and burn the offerings of sacrifice, then the priest shall perform the ritual over the altar.
verses.11: And the flesh of the sheep, and all its organs on its head, its legs, and its body.
verses.12: And he brought out all the fruit onto the outside of the camp, to a clean place, to the edge of the stream. Then he burned it on trees over the edge of the stream.
verses.13: And if all of Israel is destroyed, and something is hidden from the eyes of the people, and they violate one of Jehovah’s commandments that they were supposed to obey, then they will be punished.
verses.14: And they knew the sin they had committed. They offered a calf as an offering for their sins, and brought it before the altar.
verses.15: And the elders of the congregation laid their hands on the head of the grain offering before Jehovah. Then they slaughtered the grain offering before Jehovah.
verses.16: And the priest shall bring the Passover lamb from the blood of the lamb into the sanctuary.
verses.17: And the priest shall dip his finger into the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before Jehovah, in front of the altar.
verses.18: And from that blood, it shall be poured over the horns of the altar that stands before the LORD in the Temple of Moses. All that blood shall be poured into the trench at the entrance of the Temple of Moses.
verses.19: And all its milk was poured out from it, and the furnace was filled with it.
verses.20: And he will do to the goat what he did to the goat of sin. Then the priest will forgive them.
verses.21: And he brought the grain outside the camp and burned it, just as he had burned the first grain. This was an act of sin by the entire community.
verses.22: Whoever transgresses and violates one of the commandments of Jehovah, God his Lord, so that it is not done in ignorance or negligence.
verses.23: Or, he knew about his sin; he had sinned in it. And he brought forth a wild ram as a sacrifice to God.
verses.24: And he placed his hand on the head of the sheep, and slaughtered it in the same place where the lamb was slaughtered before Jehovah for sin.
verses.25: And the priest took some blood from the sinner’s wound on his forehead, and applied it to the horns of the idol of the sun. Then he poured that blood into the altar of the sun god.
verses.26: And all of its milk shall be used by the priest as an offering for sacrifices. It will be like milk used in the sacrifices of offerings. And the priest shall sprinkle it on it as an atonement for his sins, and he will be forgiven.
verses.27: And if one person sins through ignorance, among the people of this land, in doing one of Jehovah’s commandments that should not be done. Then I will bring judgment upon them.
verses.28: Or, he knew about his sin. He had sinned, and he brought upon himself the punishment of a innocent lamb that was sacrificed for his sins.
verses.29: And he laid his hand on the head of the sin, and cut off that sin from its place.
verses.30: And the priest took some blood from the wound on its edge, and applied it to the horns of the altar. Then he poured all the blood onto the altar’s altar.
verses.31: And all its milk shall be removed, just as milk is removed from the offering of sacrifices. Then the priest shall burn incense as an aroma pleasing to God. And the priest shall sprinkle it on it, and it will be forgiven.
verses.32: And if Kebesh brings his sacrifice to a sin of impurity, he will bring it along with him.
verses.33: And he laid his hand on the head of the sin, and cut it off in place where the upper part of the body is cut off.
verses.34: And the priest took some of the blood from the sin offering, and he applied it to the horns of the altar. All of the blood was then poured into the trench around the altar.
verses.35: And all the blood shall be removed when the lamb is removed from the altar of sacrifices. Then the priest shall burn those offerings on the altar before Jehovah. And the priest shall sprinkle the blood over his sin, for he has sinned; but he will be forgiven.
